subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): let runtime completions request reasoning

question: Should `runtime.llm.complete` permanently expose the canonical `ThinkLevel` as an additive public plugin SDK parameter?
rationale: The code change is mechanically narrow, but adding a plugin API field creates a shipped external contract whose naming, type ownership, and long-term semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve canonical reasoning field
options.body: Adopt the optional `reasoning: ThinkLevel` contract and merge after live provider proof confirms the existing normalization path.

options.title: Keep the SDK unchanged
options.body: Decline the new public contract and close or redesign the linked request around another already-supported plugin runtime surface.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical reasoning field
recommendation.body: Adopt the optional `reasoning: ThinkLevel` contract and merge after live provider proof confirms the existing normalization path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest involvement with the prepared simple-completion runtime and its public-facing completion behavior.
